item.title: Chinese couple who flew to S’pore just to scam others sentenced to jail for cheating case at Joo Koon
item.description: A Chinese couple who travelled to Singapore specifically to scam strangers have been sentenced to jail after targeting a victim in Joo Koon.

item.title: Fire breaks out at Koufu coffeeshop in Commonwealth, no injuries reported
item.description: A fire broke out at a Koufu coffeeshop in Commonwealth, which involved the contents of a stall, said SCDF.

item.title: S'pore secondary schools to ban use of smartphones during school hours, including recess & CCAs
item.description: Next year, Singapore secondary school students will not be allowed to use smartphones during school hours, including recess and CCAs.

item.title: 5-room Bishan flat sold for S$1.632M, becomes S’pore’s second-priciest resale HDB unit
item.description: A five-room HDB flat in Bishan has been sold for S$1.632 million, becoming Singapore second-priciest resale unit.

item.title: PMD rider in critical condition after accident in Punggol, family appeals for witnesses
item.description: A PMD rider is in critical condition after meeting with a presumed accident in Punggol. His family is appealing for witnesses.

item.title: Tourist from China slammed after allegedly letting child defecate in public at South Korean national park
item.description: A tourist from China was caught letting her child defecate in public in the Hallasan National Park on Jeju Island, South Korea.

item.title: Meta AI & Ray-Ban launch new Gen 2 glasses with enhanced camera resolution & longer battery life
item.description: The new Ray-Ban Meta (Gen 2) glasses offer a suite of features, including enhanced video quality and twice the battery life.

item.title: Thailand to crack down on travellers making multiple visa-free long visits, immigration to run enhanced checks
item.description: Thailand is tightening its borders to stop foreigners from abusing its visa-free entry scheme, adding enhanced checks for long-stayers.

item.title: Man caught littering in S'pore carpark hurls vulgarities & tells others to 'go back M'sia' when confronted
item.description: A man caught littering in a Singapore carpark told the complainant to 'go back Malaysia', showing middle fingers amidst angry yelling.

item.title: S’pore gym user shares nasty encounter with 'entitled' gym-goer, asks how others would react
item.description: A routine cooldown at the gym turned frustrating for one user, who took to Reddit to vent an encounter with an “entitled” fellow gym-goer.
